methods.name: createCustomMiniFolio
methods.desc:
Create a mini-folio out of asset and overlay descriptions.

Schema for the mini folio description:
|| Key || Type || Required? || Description ||
| contentstackid | string | yes | The explicit ID to be used for this stack |
| tocImage | file | no | The TOC image for the mini-folio |
| narrowdimension | int | no | Targetted export size, measured along narrow dimension |
| widedimension | int | no | Targetted export size, measured along wide dimension |
| smoothscrolling | @enum(SmoothScrollingOptions) | no | The smooth scrolling behavior for this stack (default is noSmoothScroll) |
| locationforgeneratedassets | file | no | If included, this is an existing directory where the generated assets should be created. |
| overlays | array | no | see the SDK Overlay Builder APIs |
| assets | array | yes | The assets for the mini - folio, described below. |
| assetDependencies | array | no | Files that are needed by the asset, that will be included in the package but not the manifest. |
| metadata | array | no | The metadata for the mini-folio described below. |
| showprogressbar | boolean | no | Either true or false to indicate whether we should show a progress bar (default is false) |
| targetviewerversion | string | no | If provided (in the form "major.minor.revision") a folio compatible with the viewer version is produced. If omitted, the latest folio format is produced. | CS5 |

The following are fields in the array for "assets":
|| Key || Type || Required? || Description ||
| file | file | yes | The asset file |
| type | string | yes | The asset file type, either "web" for HTML or "image" for a raster |
| width | int | yes | The asset width |
| height | int | yes | The asset height |
| orientation | string | yes | The asset orientation, either "portrait" or "landscape" |
| thumbnail | file | no | A thumbnail of the asset to be used in browse mode |
| scrubber | file | no | A thumbnail of the asset to be used in scrubber mode |

The following are fields in the array for "assetDependencies":
|| Key || Type || Required? || Description ||
| file | file | no | The dependent file |
| relativePath | string | no | The relative path to the file, for use in the package |

The following are fields in the array for "metadata":
|| Key || Type || Required? || Description ||
| any string | string or boolean | no | any key/value where the key is a string, and the value is either a string or a boolean, such as those described in "export folio meta data" |

params.name: miniFolioDescription
params.desc: A dictionary describing the custom mini folio to create. Can accept: Ordered array containing key:String, value:Boolean, Long Integer, Long Long Integer, String, File or Array of Any Types.

params.desc: The location to write the file.

methods.desc: Adjust the existing layout according to new page size, bleed and margin values. The first parameter is a plain object with key value pairs for properties affected. Permissible keys are width, height, bleedInside, bleedTop, bleedOutside, bleedBottom, leftMargin, topMargin, rightMargin, bottomMargin. The values can be specified as decimal numbers in units of Pt or as a string having a measurement value such as '1 in'. Not all properties need to be specified, only the values that need updation. Notice that when dealing with individual pages rather than the whole document, bleed changes has no effect. E.g. - app.activeDocument.adjustLayout({width:'600px', leftMargin: '1in'}), app.activeDocument.adjustLayout({rightMargin:'1in'}, app.activeDocument.spreads[0].pages), app.activeDocument.spreads[0].pages[0].adjustLayout({width:'400px', leftMargin: '10px'})

props.desc: Controls the flex item's height behavior (fixed, auto, fill). Can return: FlexWidthHeightMode enumerator or FlexEnum enumerator.

props.name: name
props.desc: The name of the MediaItem.

props.desc: The shape to be applied to the top left corner of rectangular shapes and all corners of non-rectangular shapes.Note: corner option differs from end join in which you can set a radius for a corner option, whereas the rounded or beveled effect of an end join depends on the stroke weight.

props.name: topRightCornerOption
props.desc: The shape to apply to the top right corner of rectangular shapes

props.name: bottomLeftCornerOption
props.desc: The shape to apply to the bottom left corner of rectangular shapes.

props.name: bottomRightCornerOption
props.desc: The shape to apply to the bottom right corner of rectangular shapes.

props.desc: The radius in measurement units of the corner effect applied to the top left corner of rectangular shapes and all corners of non-rectangular shapes

props.name: topRightCornerRadius

props.name: bottomLeftCornerRadius

props.name: bottomRightCornerRadius

props.name: verticalLayoutConstraints
props.desc: The top margin, height, and bottom margin constraints this item is subject to when using the object-based layout rule.

props.name: geometricBounds
props.desc: The bounds of the MediaItem excluding the stroke width, in the format [y1, x1, y2, x2], which give the coordinates of the top-left and bottom-right corners of the bounding box.

props.name: visibleBounds
props.desc: The bounds of the MediaItem including the stroke width, in the format [y1, x1, y2, x2], which give the coordinates of the top-left and bottom-right corners of the bounding box.

props.desc: The swatch (color, gradient, tint, or mixed ink) applied to the fill of the MediaItem. . Can also accept: String.

props.desc: If true, the MediaItem's fill color overprints any underlying objects. If false, the fill color knocks out the underlying colors.

props.name: strokeWeight
props.desc: The weight (in points) to apply to the MediaItem's stroke.

props.name: miterLimit

props.name: strokeType

props.name: strokeCornerAdjustment

props.desc: The arrowhead applied to the start of the path.

props.name: rightLineEnd

props.desc: The starting point (in page coordinates) of a gradient applied to the fill of the MediaItem, in the format [x, y].

props.name: gradientFillLength
props.desc: The length (for a linear gradient) or radius (for a radial gradient) applied to the fill of the MediaItem.

props.desc: The angle of a linear gradient applied to the fill of the MediaItem. (Range: -180 to 180)

props.name: gradientStrokeStart

props.desc: If true, the MediaItem's stroke color overprints any underlying objects. If false, the stroke color knocks out the  underlying colors.

props.name: useSecurity
props.desc: If true, activates security controls for the PDF document.

props.name: openDocumentPassword
props.desc: The password to enter when opening the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true. Note: A script can set but not get this value.

props.name: changeSecurityPassword
props.desc: Changes the open document password to the specified string. Valid only when use security is true. Note: A script can set but not get this value.

props.name: disallowPrinting
props.desc: If true, users cannot print the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowChanging
props.desc: If true, users cannot fill in forms, sign, extract pages, or add comments in the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowCopying
props.desc: If true, users cannot copy and paste text, images, or other content from the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowNotes
props.desc: If true, users cannot add or change notes, edit text, or fill in form fields in the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowFormFillIn
props.desc: If true, users cannot change form fields in the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowExtractionForAccessibility
props.desc: If true, users cannot extract content from the PDF document using software tools for the visually impaired. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowDocumentAssembly
props.desc: If true, users cannot insert, delete, or rotate pages in the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowHiResPrinting
props.desc: If true, users cannot print high-resolution copies of the PDF document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: disallowPlaintextMetadata
props.desc: If true and acrobat compatibility is Acrobat 6 or higher, storage systems and search engines cannot access metadata stored in the PDF document. If true and acrobat compatibility is acrobat 5 or higher, users cannot copy and extract content from the document. Valid only when use security is true.

props.name: viewPDF
props.desc: If true, automatically opens the PDF file after exporting.

props.name: subsetFontsBelow
props.desc: Sets the threshold for embedding complete fonts based on how many of the fonts' characters are used in the document. If the percentage of characters used in the document for any given font exceeds the specified value, the font is completely embedded; otherwise, the font is subsetted. (Range: 0 to 100) Notes: Embedding complete fonts increases file size. To completely embed all fonts, use 0 (zero).

props.name: pdfColorSpace
props.desc: The color space to use to represent color information in the exported PDF document.

props.name: includeICCProfiles
props.desc: The ICC Profiles to include in the exported PDF document. Can also accept: Boolean.

props.name: omitEPS
props.desc: If true, replaces EPS images with OPI links.

props.name: omitPDF
props.desc: If true, replaces PDF images with OPI links.

props.name: omitBitmaps
props.desc: If true, replaces bitmap images with OPI links.

props.name: cropImagesToFrames
props.desc: If true, image data that falls outside the visible portion of an image's frame is not exported to the PDF document.

props.name: generateThumbnails
props.desc: If true, generates thumbnail images for each page or spread.

props.name: optimizePDF
props.desc: If true, optimizes the exported PDF document for faster viewing in a web browser. Note: Compresses text and line art, regardless of specified compression settings.

props.name: includeStructure
props.desc: If true, creates a tagged PDF file. Note: If acrobat compatibility is acrobat 6 or higher, tags are visible only when the PDF is opened in Acrobat 6 or higher.

props.name: acrobatCompatibility
props.desc: The exported PDF document's Acrobat compatibility.

props.name: simulateOverprint
props.desc: If true, simulates the effects of overprinting spot inks with different neutral density values by converting spot colors to process colors for printing. Note: Not valid when the color output mode is defined to leave color profiles unchanged.

props.name: pdfDestinationProfile
props.desc: The gamut of the final RGB or CMYK device. Can return: PDFProfileSelector enumerator or String.

props.name: pdfXProfile
props.desc: The PDF X color profile to use for the PDF document. . Can return: PDFProfileSelector enumerator or String.

props.name: includeHyperlinks
props.desc: If true, includes hyperlinks when exporting the document.

props.name: includeBookmarks
props.desc: If true, displays bookmarks and table of contents entries as links in the bookmarks pane in the PDF document. If false, no bookmarks are exported.

props.name: exportNonprintingObjects
props.desc: If true, makes non-printing objects visible in the PDF document.

props.name: exportGuidesAndGrids
props.desc: If true, includes visible guides and baseline grids in the PDF document.

props.name: exportLayers

props.name: standardsCompliance

methods.desc: Adjust the existing layout according to new page size, bleed and margin values. The first parameter is a plain object with key value pairs for properties affected. Permissible keys are width, height, bleedInside, bleedTop, bleedOutside, bleedBottom, leftMargin, topMargin, rightMargin, bottomMargin. The values can be specified as decimal numbers in units of Pt or as a string having a measurement value such as '1 in'. Not all properties need to be specified, only the values that need updation. props.name: gradientStrokeStart

params.name: in
params.desc: The coordinate space to use

params.name: from

type.name: any
alternatives: Array of Arrays of 2 Reals, CoordinateSpaces enumerators, AnchorPoint enumerators, BoundingBoxLimits enumerators, Long Integers

params.desc: The temporary origin during the transformation. Can accept: Array of 2 Reals, AnchorPoint enumerator or Array of Arrays of 2 Reals, CoordinateSpaces enumerators, AnchorPoint enumerators, BoundingBoxLimits enumerators or Long Integers.

params.name: withMatrix
params.desc: Transform matrix. Can accept: Array of 6 Reals or TransformationMatrix.

params.name: replacingCurrent
params.desc: Transform components to consider; providing this optional parameter causes the target's existing transform components to be replaced with new values.  Without this parameter, the given matrix is concatenated onto the target's existing transform combining the effect of the two. Can accept: MatrixContent enumerator, Array of MatrixContent enumerators or Long Integer. (Optional)

params.desc: The location requested. Can accept: Array of 2 Reals, AnchorPoint enumerator or Array of Arrays of 2 Reals, CoordinateSpaces enumerators, AnchorPoint enumerators, BoundingBoxLimits enumerators or Long Integers.

params.name: in
params.desc: The coordinate space to use.

methods.name: resize
methods.desc: Resize the page item.

params.name: in

type.name: any
alternatives: Ordered array containing coordinateSpace:CoordinateSpaces enumerator, boundsKind:BoundingBoxLimits enumerator

params.desc: The bounding box to resize. Can accept: CoordinateSpaces enumerator, BoundingBoxLimits enumerator or Ordered array containing coordinateSpace:CoordinateSpaces enumerator, boundsKind:BoundingBoxLimits enumerator.

params.name: from

type.name: any
alternatives: Array of Arrays of 2 Reals, CoordinateSpaces enumerators, AnchorPoint enumerators, BoundingBoxLimits enumerators, Long Integers

params.desc: The transform origin. Legal specifications: relative to bounding box: anchor | {anchor | {x,y}, bounds kind [, coordinate space]}; relative to coordinate space: {x,y} | {{x,y}[, coordinate space]}; relative to layout window ruler: {{x,y}, page index | bounds kind}. Can accept: Array of 2 Reals, AnchorPoint enumerator or Array of Arrays of 2 Reals, CoordinateSpaces enumerators, AnchorPoint enumerators, BoundingBoxLimits enumerators or Long Integers.

params.name: by
params.desc: How the current dimensions are affected by the given values

params.name: values

type.name: any
alternatives: Array of Reals, ResizeConstraints enumerators, CoordinateSpaces enumerators

params.desc: The width and height values. Legal dimensions specifications: {x, y [, coordinate space]}, {x, resize constraint [, coordinate space]}, or {resize constraint, y [, coordinate space]}; where x and y are real numbers and coordinate space is used to determine _only_ the unit of length for x and y; coordinate space is ignored for the 'current dimensions times' resize method). Can accept: Array of Reals, ResizeConstraints enumerators or CoordinateSpaces enumerators.

params.name: resizeIndividually
params.desc: If false and multiple page items are targeted, the new dimensions are attained only by moving the individual items rather than resizing them. (Optional)

params.name: consideringRulerUnits
params.desc: If true then a ruler location is interpreted using ruler units rather than points. The default value is false. This parameter has no effect unless the reference point is specified relative to a page. (Optional)

For information, see dialog column, dialog row, static text, border panel, enabling group, radiobutton group, checkbox control, angle editbox, angle combobox, integer editbox, integer combobox, measurement editbox, measurement combobox, percent editbox, percent combobox, real editbox, real combobox, and text editbox.

props.name: rubyAlignment
props.desc: The ruby alignment.

props.name: rubyPosition
props.desc: The position of ruby characters relative to the parent text.

props.name: rubyXOffset
props.desc: The amount of horizontal space between ruby and parent characters.

props.name: rubyYOffset
props.desc: The amount of vertical space between ruby and parent characters.

props.name: rubyParentSpacing
props.desc: The ruby spacing relative to the parent text.

props.name: rubyAutoAlign
props.desc: If true, auto aligns ruby.

props.name: rubyOverhang
props.desc: If true, constrains ruby overhang to the specified amount. For information on specifying an amount, see ruby parent overhang amount.

props.name: rubyAutoScaling
props.desc: If true, automatically scales ruby to the specified percent of parent text size. For information on specifying a percent, see ruby parent scaling percent.

props.name: rubyParentScalingPercent
props.desc: The amount (as a percentage) to scale the parent text size to determine the ruby text size.

props.name: rubyParentOverhangAmount
props.desc: The amount by which ruby characters can overhang the parent text.

props.name: warichu
props.desc: If true, turns on warichu.

props.name: warichuSize
props.desc: The amount (as a percentage) to scale parent text size to determine warichu size.

props.name: warichuLines
props.desc: The number of lines of warichu within a single normal line.

props.name: warichuLineSpacing
props.desc: The gap between lines of warichu characters.

props.name: warichuAlignment
props.desc: The warichu alignment.

props.name: warichuCharsAfterBreak
props.desc: The minimum number of characters allowed after a line break.

props.name: warichuCharsBeforeBreak
props.desc: The minimum number of characters allowed before a line break.

props.name: otfProportionalMetrics
props.desc: If true, kerns according to proportional CJK metrics in OpenType fonts.

props.name: otfHVKana
props.desc: If true, switches hiragana fonts, which have different glyphs for horizontal and vertical.

props.name: otfRomanItalics
props.desc: If true, applies italics to half-width alphanumerics.

props.name: scaleAffectsLineHeight
props.desc: If true, the line changes size when characters are scaled.

props.name: cjkGridTracking
props.desc: If true, uses grid tracking to track non-Roman characters in CJK grids.

props.name: glyphForm
props.desc: The glyph variant to substitute for standard glyphs.

props.name: rubyFlag
props.desc: If true, ruby is on.

props.name: rubyString
props.desc: The ruby string contents.

props.name: gridAlignFirstLineOnly
props.desc: If true, aligns only the first line to the frame grid or baseline grid. If false, aligns all lines to the grid.

props.name: gridAlignment
props.desc: The alignment to the frame grid or baseline grid.

props.name: gridGyoudori
props.desc: The manual gyoudori setting.

props.name: autoTcy
props.desc: The number of half-width characters at or below which the characters automatically run horizontally in vertical text.

props.name: autoTcyIncludeRoman
props.desc: If true, auto tcy includes Roman characters.

props.name: kinsokuSet
props.desc: The kinsoku set that determines legitimate line breaks. Can return: KinsokuTable, KinsokuSet enumerator or String.

props.name: kinsokuType
props.desc: The type of kinsoku processing for preventing kinsoku characters from beginning or ending a line. Note: Valid only when a kinsoku set is defined.

props.name: kinsokuHangType
props.desc: The type of hanging punctuation to allow. Note: Valid only when a kinsoku set is in effect.

props.name: bunriKinshi
props.desc: If true, adds the double period (..), ellipse (...), and double hyphen (--) to the selected kinsoku set. Note: Valid only when a kinsoku set is in effect.

props.name: mojikumi
props.desc: The mojikumi table. For information, see mojikumi table defaults. Can return: MojikumiTable, String or MojikumiTableDefaults enumerator.

props.name: rensuuji
props.desc: If true, disallows line breaks in numbers. If false, lines can break between digits in multi-digit numbers.

props.name: rotateSingleByteCharacters
props.desc: If true, rotates Roman characters in vertical text.

props.name: leadingModel
props.desc: The point from which leading is measured from line to line.

props.name: rubyAutoTcyDigits
props.desc: The number of digits included in auto tcy (tate-chuu-yoko) in ruby.

props.name: rubyAutoTcyIncludeRoman
props.desc: If true, includes Roman characters in auto tcy (tate-chuu-yoko) in ruby.

props.name: rubyAutoTcyAutoScale
props.desc: If true, automatically scales glyphs in auto tcy (tate-chuu-yoko) in ruby to fit one em.

props.name: treatIdeographicSpaceAsSpace
props.desc: If true, ideographic spaces will not wrap to the next line like text characters.

props.name: allowArbitraryHyphenation
props.desc: If true, words unassociated with a hyphenation dictionary can break to the next line on any character.

props.name: paragraphGyoudori
props.desc: If true, the gyoudori mode applies to the entire paragraph. If false, the gyoudori mode applies to each line in the paragraph.

props.name: bulletsAndNumberingListType
props.desc: List type for bullets and numbering.

props.name: bulletsCharacterStyle
props.desc: The character style to be used for the text after string. Can return: CharacterStyle or String.

props.name: numberingCharacterStyle
props.desc: The character style to be used for the number string. Can return: CharacterStyle or String.

props.name: numberingExpression
props.desc: The number string expression for numbering.

props.name: bulletsTextAfter
props.desc: The text after string expression for bullets.

props.name: appliedNumberingList
props.desc: The list to be part of. Can return: NumberingList or String.

props.name: numberingLevel
props.desc: The level of the paragraph.

props.name: numberingFormat
props.desc: Numbering format options. Can return: NumberingStyle enumerator or String.

props.name: numberingContinue
props.desc: Continue the numbering at this level.

props.name: numberingStartAt
props.desc: Determines starting number in a numbered list.

props.name: numberingApplyRestartPolicy
props.desc: If true, apply the numbering restart policy.

props.name: bulletsAlignment
props.desc: The alignment of the bullet character.

props.name: numberingAlignment
props.desc: The alignment of the number.

props.name: trackChanges
props.desc: If true, track changes is turned on.

props.name: storyTitle
props.desc: Title for this InCopy story.

props.name: appliedNamedGrid
props.desc: The named grid in use.

props.name: label
props.desc: A property that can be set to any string.

props.name: name
props.desc: The name of the XmlStory; this is an alias to the XmlStory's label property.

props.name: properties
props.desc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

params.desc: Index of design axis.

methods.name: asynchronousExportFile
methods.desc: asynchronously exports the object(s) to a file.

params.desc: The export format, specified as an enumeration value or as an extension that appears in the Save as type or Format menu in the Export dialog. Can accept: ExportFormat enumerator or String.

params.name: to
params.desc: The path to the export file.

params.name: showingOptions
params.desc: If true, displays the export options dialog. (Optional)

params.name: using
params.desc: The export style. (Optional)

params.name: versionComments
params.desc: The comment for this version. (Optional)

params.name: forceSave

methods.name: createOutlines
methods.desc: Converts text to outlines. Each line of text becomes a polygon object. When the converted text is a single letter that has no internal spaces or detached parts, the polygon contains only a single path. Note: To determine whether a font allows the creation of outlines, see allow outlines.

params.name: deleteOriginal
params.desc: If true, deletes the original text. If false, creates the outlines as separate object(s) on top of the text.  (Optional)
